_about: The branch of Andrew Kastl, one of the seven brothers. See docs/EXTRACTION.md.

facts.value: 27 November 1853, Stara Hut, house No. 1, Bohemia

sources.quote: Andrew Kastl was born 27 November 1853 in Stara Hut, Bohemia, house No. 1
Andrew died 5 May 1906, and was buried at Plasi, Saunders County, Nebraska.
was buried at Plasi, Saunders County, Nebraska.

facts.value: Arrived at Baltimore 29 May 1867, aged 13, with his brother Thomas

sources.quote: young Andrew and his brother Thomas arrived at the Port of Baltimore 29 May 1867 on the ship Johannes—Wilhelmine which sailed from Bremen, Germany.
The next to arrive May 29, 1867, were Andrew, age 13 and Thomas, age 17.
